Fig 1: Figure 1: Deep_AA Introduction

Archetypal R² = 0.8317. Measures how much variance in the PCA space is explained by the learned archetypal coordinate system. Analogous to R² in regression: 1.0 = perfect reconstruction of cell positions from archetype weights. Higher R² means the simplex geometry captures the data structure well.
